Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)

Move:     +55bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year real (TIPS) yield rose to 2.44 from a trailing-90-day low of 1.89, a 0.55pp climb, as of 2026-09-01.

内容:
10 年期实际利率（TIPS 收益率）从过去 90 天低点 1.89 升至 2.44，涨了 0.55 个百分点，截至 2026-09-01。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields tighten financial conditions and raise the discount rate applied to long-duration AI-capex cash flows, directly pressuring the valuations that depend on those future payoffs. C10 mirrors C7's structure — this crossing the 2x-trigger threshold escalates it from MED to HIGH.

影响:
实际利率上升会收紧金融条件，也会提高 AI capex 那些长久期未来现金流的贴现率，直接压低依赖这些回报的估值。C10 结构和 C7 一致，这次涨幅越过 2 倍触发阈值，级别从 MED 升到 HIGH。

alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-08-31
Current:  2.44%
90d low:  1.89%
Move:     +55bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
10-year TIPS real yield jumped to 2.44 from a trailing-90-day low of 1.89, a rise of 0.55 percentage points as of 2026-08-31.

内容:
10年期 TIPS 实际收益率从近90天低点 1.89 跳升至 2.44，上升 0.55 个百分点（截至 2026-08-31）。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields tighten financial conditions and raise the discount rate applied to long-duration AI-capex bets, compressing the valuations that depend on cheap, patient capital. This is a broad liquidity thermometer, not an AI-specific fuse — it flags rising stress across the whole trade, not just one company.

影响:
实际收益率上升会收紧金融环境，同时抬高长久期 AI capex 押注所用的折现率，压缩那些依赖便宜、耐心资本的估值。这是广谱流动性温度计，不是 AI 专属引信——它标示的是整个交易面的压力上升，不针对某一家公司。

alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22HBM%22+OR+%22memory+chip%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 15:56:52 GMT Link: https://news.google.?oc=5 Consumer Tech Prices Surge Amid Global Memory Chip Crunch - Statista Consumer Tech Prices Surge Amid Global Memory Chip Crunch  Statista ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: A news item reports consumer tech prices surging amid a global memory chip crunch, with DRAM/NAND supply tightness cited as the driver. 内容: 一则新闻报道称，受全球内存芯片供应紧张影响，消费电子产品价格正在上涨，DRAM/NAND 供应吃紧被点名为主因。 Why it matters: Memory price spikes raise the input-cost floor for every AI server build (HBM/DRAM feed directly into accelerator bill-of-materials), and a genuine supply crunch signals demand from AI infrastructure buildout is now bidding away capacity from the consumer channel — a sign the capex cycle is straining real-world supply chains, not just financial ones. 影响: 内存价格上涨会直接推高每一台 AI 服务器的物料成本（HBM/DRAM 是加速卡 BOM 的核心部分）；而真实的供应紧张说明 AI 基础设施建设的需求正在从消费级渠道抢占产能——这是资本开支周期挤压实体供应链的信号，不只是财务层面的紧张。

It's evidence of the ecosystem's interlocking capital structure, not new capex or distress data, so it stays a background MED signal for the C3 thesis. 影响: 这是 AI 基础设施里典型的循环融资——芯片厂商出资支持数据中心/电力供应商的建设，而最大的算力买家又在同一个载体里持有股权上行空间。这条只是揭示了生态圈资本结构互相嵌套，不涉及新增 capex 或财务困境数据，对 C3 论点来说属于背景级 MED 信号。

alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.42% (+53bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-08-28
Current:  2.42%
90d low:  1.89%
Move:     +53bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year TIPS-derived real yield jumped to 2.42% on 2026-08-28, up 0.53pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.89%, crossing C10's 2x-trigger threshold for a HIGH escalation.

内容:
10年期 TIPS 隐含实际收益率在 2026-08-28 升至 2.42%，比过去 90 天低点 1.89% 高出 0.53 个百分点，触发了 C10 的 2 倍地板，升级为 HIGH。

Why it matters:
Real yields this high raise the discount rate applied to long-duration AI capex bets and make the risk-free alternative to speculative growth assets much more attractive. A sustained move here pressures the same high-multiple AI names that a credit or neocloud fuse would hit, just through the rates channel instead of the credit channel.

影响:
实际利率这么高，会拉高对 AI 长周期资本开支的折现率，同时让无风险资产比高估值成长股更有吸引力。这个信号走的是利率渠道，跟信用或 neocloud 引信打的是同一批高估值 AI 股票，只是路径不同。

alerts.body:
Severity:  MED

Published: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 18:21:11 GMT

Anthropic IPO Could Open AI Listings Floodgates: Madrona

The IA40 list from Madrona is back, spotlighting the private companies shaping the next phase of AI. Matt McIlwain, managing director at Madrona, explains how the list is assembled, why OpenAI, Anthropic and Databricks dominate AI fundraising, and how a successful Anthropic IPO could open the door for a new wave of public offerings in 2027. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
A Bloomberg Tech segment discusses Madrona's IA40 list of top private AI companies, noting OpenAI, Anthropic and Databricks dominate private AI fundraising, and speculates that a successful Anthropic IPO could trigger more AI listings in 2027.

内容:
彭博 Bloomberg Tech 节目讨论了 Madrona 的 IA40 私营 AI 公司榜单，提到 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Databricks 主导私募 AI 融资，并推测 Anthropic 若成功 IPO，可能带动 2027 年更多 AI 公司上市。

Why it matters:

alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-08-26
Current:  2.34%
90d low:  1.89%
Move:     +45bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year real (TIPS) yield spiked to 2.34% from a trailing-90-day low of 1.89% — a 0.45pp rise as of 2026-08-26.

内容:
10年期实际收益率（TIPS）从90天低点1.89%跳升至2.34%，涨了0.45个百分点（截至2026-08-26）。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields raise the discount rate on long-duration cash flows, hitting speculative AI capex bets hardest since their payoff is furthest out. It's also a tightening-financial-conditions signal — makes debt-funded capex more expensive right when hyperscaler free cash flow is already strained.

影响:
实际收益率走高会抬高长久期现金流的折现率，对回报周期最远的AI投机性资本开支打击最大。这也是金融条件收紧的信号——偏偏在超大规模厂商自由现金流已经吃紧的时候，让举债扩产变得更贵。
